metadata.scenario_context: Jake is graduating from his masters degree and his friends, Alex and Sam, plan to go to his graduation ceremony.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada strongly disagree that whenever science and religion conflict, religion is always right.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Pakistan strongly agree that whenever science and religion conflict, religion is always right.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose on an expensive gift for Jake's graduation.
agent_1.goal_2: Question the attitude toward the conflict between scientific treatment and religious beliefs.

agent_2.goal_1: discuss what kind of gift to buy for Jake.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is acceptable to forgo scientific treatment because of religious beliefs.

shared_prefix.speaker: Sam
shared_prefix.message: Hey Sam, have you thought about what kind of gift we should get Jake for his graduation? I was thinking maybe something really special... like a high-end watch or a nice piece of tech. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Alex
shared_prefix.message: Hmm... a watch could be a nice gesture, but I think we should think about something more personal. Maybe a customized item that reflects his journey or achievements? Tech is nice, but it feels a bit impersonal for such a milestone. What about a framed photo or something that symbolizes his hard work?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Sam
shared_prefix.message: I don’t really see meaningful differences here, Sam. At the end of the day, it’s all the same—Jake will appreciate whatever we give him. turns.speaker: Alex
